subject.title: Design: run lifecycle reliability — bounded liveness, abort⇒release, crash resume, completion drive

question: Should maintainers adopt this issue as the canonical staged run-lifecycle reliability umbrella and approve the Track A-D sequencing, or keep the linked production reports as separate narrower work items?
rationale: The source evidence confirms the problem class and VISION.md supports stability work, but the proposed solution chooses cross-cutting lifecycle ownership, liveness thresholds, durability, and completion behavior across stable gateway surfaces.

options.title: Adopt staged umbrella
options.body: Approve the four invariants as the maintainer-owned direction and split Track A-D into small implementation PRs with focused source and live proof.

options.title: Approve Track A only
options.body: Treat abort-to-release and stale takeover as the near-term accepted fix while deferring liveness, durability, and completion-drive policy to separate decisions.

options.title: Keep reports separate
options.body: Decline this umbrella as canonical and continue landing narrower fixes against the existing linked production reports.

recommendation.title: Adopt staged umbrella
recommendation.body: Approve the four invariants as the maintainer-owned direction and split Track A-D into small implementation PRs with focused source and live proof.

likelyOwner.reason: obviyus authored, is assigned to, and is actively refining this umbrella and its Track A implementation PR.
